sentences.en: Without sufficient atmospheric pressure, body fluids will start to boil.
sentences.zh: 缺乏足够的大气压力，体内的液体将会开始沸腾。

sentences.en: I found the film to be very atmospheric.
sentences.zh: 我发现这部电影非常有氛围。

sentences.en: Human and animal life are influenced by their reactions to the atmospheric environment.
sentences.zh: 人类和动物的生活受到其对大气环境的反应的影响。

senses.zh: 大气的；大气层的；大气引起的 - 制造气氛的
